Number of updates to existing records per
second.

Number of distinct messages in the SOW -
defined by the SOW topic key.
For topics that maintain a history, this
shows the total number of messages that
the SOW maintains, which may be larger
than the number of messages that would
be returned by a query at the current
time, or the number of messages that
would be returned by a query at a
historical point in time.
